title: 88Vape Original Fresh Blueberry 10ml E-Liquid  - 16mg
description: 88Vape’s Fresh Blueberry, part of the Anytank series, is a High-PG e-liquid that embodies the essence of pure, ripe blueberries with a delightful syrupy undertone. This e-liquid is a testament to simplicity and authenticity, offering a rich, fruity experience that blueberry lovers will adore. Each draw is filled with the natural sweetness and subtle tartness of blueberries, balanced with a smooth, syrupy finish that enhances the overall flavour. Crafted for those who appreciate the finer nuances of fruit-based e-liquids, Fresh Blueberry delivers a refreshing and natural taste. The essence of the e-liquid is like a journey through a lush blueberry field, where every inhale brings a burst of fresh, juicy flavour, and every exhale leaves a pleasantly sweet aftertaste. The syrupy note is not overpowering; instead, it complements the blueberries, adding a layer of richness that rounds out the vape experience This High-PG e-liquid from 88Vape offers a classic vape experience with its tactile and satisfying throat hit and intense flavour delivery. Its 70%PG/30VG content makes it ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. We would not recommend using High-PG e-liquids with sub-ohm coils and more powerful vape devices. 88Vape are one of the most popular and bestselling vape brands in the UK. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at wallet-friendly prices.
